billboards.a_video_file_mp4_mov_mkv_webm: A video file (MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM...) that plays in sync with the replay. Animated GIFs and PNGs can be added as images.
billboards.add_a_keyframe_at_the_cursor_: Add a keyframe at the cursor (tick %s) and show this channel on the timeline
billboards.additive_adds_light_glows_bea: Additive adds light (glows, beams); multiply darkens; screen lightens
billboards.adds_the_overlays_and_keyfram: Adds the overlays and keyframes from a pack to this replay
billboards.animated_edits_add_a_keyframe: Animated: edits add a keyframe at tick %s
billboards.auto_reads_json_text_componen: Auto reads JSON text components, MiniMessage tags (<gradient:gold:red>, <bold>, <rainbow>...) and & formatting codes. Pick one to force it, e.g. to show MiniMessage tags as plain text
billboards.blurs_the_image_or_video_0_fo: Blurs the image or video; 0 for none
billboards.can_t_be_played_see_the_log: Can't be played; see the log
billboards.click_an_overlay_in_the_viewp: Click an overlay in the viewport to select it; drag the gizmo to edit it.
billboards.couldn_t_add_the_preset_see_t: Couldn't add the preset; see the log
billboards.couldn_t_export_the_pack_see_: Couldn't export the pack; see the log
billboards.couldn_t_save_the_preset_see_: Couldn't save the preset; see the log
billboards.crop_is_in_0_1_of_the_image_t: Crop is in 0-1 of the image. Text ignores this.
billboards.draw_order_of_see_through_ove: Draw order of see-through overlays (higher on top); the rest are sorted by distance
billboards.draw_the_overlay_on_top_of_bl: Draw the overlay on top of blocks and entities, like a see-through text display
billboards.flashback_keeps_editor_data_o: Flashback keeps editor data outside the replay file, so to give someone a replay with its overlays, send a pack too
billboards.follow_an_entity_e_g_to_pin_a: Follow an entity, e.g. to pin a label above a player's head. The position becomes an offset from the entity.
billboards.follow_an_entity_position_key: Follow an entity. Position keyframes will then be offsets from the entity.
billboards.fraction_of_the_text_shown_fo: Fraction of the text shown, for typewriter-style reveals. Images ignore this.
billboards.groups_move_rotate_scale_and_: Groups move, rotate, scale and fade everything inside them together. Add things to a group by selecting it first, or with "Move into group" in the list.
billboards.how_the_overlay_turns_towards: How the overlay turns towards the camera, like a display entity's billboard setting. Fixed uses its own rotation; the others follow the camera on some axes
billboards.inside_a_group_position_is_re: Inside a group: position is relative to the group.
billboards.lines_longer_than_this_wrap_i: Lines longer than this wrap, in font pixels (40 pixels = 1 block). Vanilla's default is 200. Make text bigger with the Scale channel
billboards.move_and_rotate_along_the_ove: Move and rotate along the overlay's own axes instead of the world's
billboards.move_in_0_25_block_steps_rota: Move in 0.25 block steps, rotate in 15° steps, scale in 0.1 steps
billboards.name: Name
billboards.no_overlays_yet_add_an_image_: No overlays yet. Add an image, text, a shape or a group.
billboards.no_presets_yet_right_click_an: No presets yet. Right-click an overlay or group in the list and choose "Save as preset..."
billboards.not_animated_auto_key_adds_a_: Not animated: auto-key adds a keyframe at tick %s
billboards.not_animated_edits_change_the: Not animated: edits change the base value
billboards.position_is_an_offset_from_th: Position is an offset from the anchor while attached.
billboards.position_keyframes_stay_as_th: Position keyframes stay as they are and become world coordinates again
billboards.position_rotation_scale_opaci: Position, rotation, scale, opacity and tint apply to everything in the group.
billboards.replay_tick_at_which_it_start: Replay tick at which it starts playing; before that it shows its first frame
billboards.reuse_overlays_with_their_ani: Reuse overlays (with their animation) in any replay. Save one by right-clicking it in the list.
billboards.rotate_the_offset_and_a_fixed: Rotate the offset (and a fixed-facing overlay) with the entity's body
billboards.saves_every_overlay_in_this_r: Saves every overlay in this replay, their files and their keyframes into one file
billboards.select_an_overlay_to_edit_it: Select an overlay to edit it.
billboards.show_or_hide_this_group_and_e: Show or hide this group and everything in it
billboards.show_or_hide_this_overlay_als: Show or hide this overlay (also in exports)
billboards.shown_as_a_magenta_checkerboa: Shown as a magenta checkerboard. Select the overlay and use Relink, or relink here.
billboards.start_again_after_the_end_ins: Start again after the end instead of holding the last frame
billboards.start_playing_at_the_timeline: Start playing at the timeline cursor
billboards.stop_following_the_entity_lea: Stop following the entity, leaving the overlay where it is now
billboards.text_can_be_styled_with_minim: Text can be styled with MiniMessage tags (<gradient:#ff8800:#ff0044>Hi</gradient>, <rainbow>, <bold>, <#33ccff>), & formatting codes (&6 gold, &l bold, &r reset), or a JSON text component. Long lines wrap at the line width.
billboards.text_that_looks_and_behaves_l: Text that looks and behaves like a vanilla text display
billboards.the_point_of_the_overlay_that: The point of the overlay that sits on its position and that it rotates around. 0.5, 0.5 is the centre
billboards.use_a_ttf_or_otf_font_file_in: Use a TTF or OTF font file instead of Minecraft's font
billboards.use_nearest_neighbour_filteri: Use nearest-neighbour filtering, for pixel art
billboards.vanilla_s_default_text_backgr: Vanilla's default text background: black, a quarter opaque
billboards.when_on_editing_a_channel_tha: When on, editing a channel that isn't animated yet adds a keyframe at the cursor instead of changing its base value
billboards.world_light_darkens_the_overl: World light darkens the overlay at night and in caves, like a vanilla text display. Custom levels work like a display entity's brightness override
